source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of input and output (PDF 36-37).

blocks.text: Input aur output ke amal program ko user se taamul karne dete hain: yeh user se data likhwa sakta (input) aur user ko maloomat dikha sakta (output) hai.

items: Input: input() paigham dikhata, user ke kuch likh kar Enter dabane ka intezar karta, aur likha hua text lautata hai jo variable mein rakha jata hai.
Output: print() ek ya zyada qeematein le kar screen par dikhata hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
name = input("Enter your name: ")
print("As-Salaam-Alaikum, " + name + "!")

blocks.prompt: age = 25; print("Age:", age) ka output kya hai (MCQ 4)?

items: input() user ka likha text leta hai; print() output dikhata hai.
